categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies scripts under `ci/test/` to run tcpdump and fail CI if unexpected network traffic is detected.
categories.rationale: Adds automated CI checking via `tcpdump` to catch inadvertent outbound network traffic during test execution, improving test hermeticity and CI reliability.

categories.name: tests

categories.rationale: Enforces test isolation and hermeticity across unit and functional tests by failing runs that trigger unexpected external DNS queries or internet traffic.
